name: For TriveniRetailGuardAI_Inventory Investigation_ E2E & UI Testing

nodes.name: Summary Node
nodes.notes:
Output shape: totalRecords, inventoryAlerts, discountAlerts, returnsAlerts, recordsRequiringReview, recordsWithValidationIssues, cases[]

Example:
{
  "totalRecords": 3,
  "inventoryAlerts": 1,
  "discountAlerts": 1,
  "returnsAlerts": 0,
  "recordsRequiringReview": 2,
  "recordsWithValidationIssues": 3,
  "cases": [
    { "Case ID": "RG-0001", "Store ID": "S003", "Product ID": "P0014", "Category": "Groceries",
      "Inventory Variance (actual - expected)": 0, "Review Priority": "Review",
      "Inventory Alert": "...", "Evidence / Explanation": "...", "Recommended Next Check": "..." }
  ]
}

nodes.name: Verify Browserless UI
nodes.notes: https://production-sfo.browserless.io/function (token is supplied by the Browserless credential)

nodeGroups.name: Publish and check UI
nodeGroups.description: Sends the summary to the RetailGuard app, pauses briefly, then takes a Browserless screenshot of the UI

nodeGroups.name: Email run report
nodeGroups.description: Marks the run as passed or failed and emails the summary with the screenshot or error details attached
